name: Becoming a Parent
summary: Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands has found the egg much further along than expected, and wants a word with you about it.

sections.title: Sooner Than Expected
sections.body: Agnar Beastamer was not prepared for how ready the egg turned out to be. Speak with Agnar in the Hinterlands, where you have been bringing food for the hatchling.

sections.title: A Parent, of a Sort
sections.body: Agnar hands the egg over, so that it will bond to you and look to you as its parent. Agnar congratulates you on becoming a parent, of a sort.

faq.q: Who has news about the egg?
faq.answer: Agnar Beastamer, who has been looking after the egg in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Where do I find Agnar Beastamer?

faq.answer: It follows Food for Baby, in which you gathered meat for the hatchling.
